minutes.headline: Planning Board approved the 757 Chase Road site plan and stormwater permit, then the 150 Holmen Street lots and permit.
minutes.summary: At its last fully remote meeting the board granted waivers, closed hearings and approved the Chase Road dealership rebuild with conditions on soil testing, pipe size, septic and annual stormwater reporting. It endorsed the ANR plan and stormwater permit for the seven-lot Holmen Street project, and reviewed the master plan bid document. Members also discussed the hybrid meeting format, a standard stormwater permit and standard conditions, and 40B affordability.

Staff to finalize master plan bid, send to assistant town manager for central register advertising; consultant start expected early fall.
Stormwater permit standards and standard conditions to be put on the June 28 agenda, continuing July 12 if needed.
Staff to alert the 711 Mass Ave applicant it may be in the watershed protection district.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the 757 Chase Road site plan and stormwater permit with conditions, 3-0.
Before that vote, the board waived the vertical datum, stamped elevations, traffic impact and community and fiscal impact requirements, then closed the hearings.
The board approved the ANR plan for 150 Holmen Street, then the Holmen Street stormwater permit with conditions, including annual maintenance reports.
Staff will finalize the master plan bid for central register advertising, with a consultant start expected in early fall.
The board set stormwater permit standards and standard conditions for the June 28 agenda, continuing July 12 if needed.

why_it_matters: The two approvals set conditions on stormwater, septic and construction hours that bind the Chase Road and Holmen Street sites, and the annual stormwater reports are the mechanism for checking them.
Standard stormwater conditions, once adopted, would apply to future applicants, and the master plan bid starts the process that guides later zoning proposals residents may be asked to vote on.
watch_next: June 28 Planning Board agenda: stormwater permit standards and standard conditions, continuing July 12 if needed.
The master plan bid advertisement in the central register, with a consultant start expected in early fall.
